description.fr-FR: Le discours de réception de Fénelon à l’Académie française (1693), son mémoire sur les occupations de l’Académie et la Lettre à M. Dacier (1714) : projet de grammaire, rhétorique, poétique, histoire, et jugement sur les anciens et les modernes.
description.en-US: Fénelon’s reception speech at the Académie française (1693), his memoir on the Academy’s occupations and the Letter to M. Dacier (1714): plans for a grammar, rhetoric, poetics and history, and a judgment on the ancients and moderns.
description.pt-BR: O discurso de recepção de Fénelon na Academia Francesa (1693), seu memorial sobre as ocupações da Academia e a Carta ao sr. Dacier (1714): projetos de gramática, retórica, poética e história, e um juízo sobre antigos e modernos.

fr-FR.editor: J.-E.-A. Gosselin (éd. Saint-Sulpice), Paris: Leroux et Jouby / Gaume

sources.edition: Œuvres complètes de Fénelon, Paris, Leroux et Jouby, 1851 (éd. Gosselin, Saint-Sulpice), tome 6, p. 573–650; archive.org OCR (ABBYY).
sources.description: Machine-cleaned OCR: running heads, page numbers and hyphenation removed, paragraphs rejoined, obvious character errors corrected by a vote against the corpus vocabulary; period spelling kept. Residual OCR errors remain (see PROBLEMS.md).
sources.tierEvidence: Fénelon died in 1715; the 1851 edition is public domain.
